nodes.label: Three layers: calendar, separation, kiln seasons
nodes.norm_label: three layers: calendar, separation, kiln seasons
nodes.rationale: Harmonized calendar is the core and ships in every outcome; kiln layers depend on gate G1.

nodes.label: Harmonization engine (harmonize.py)
nodes.rationale: Technical core. Aqua is the anchor because its 13:30/01:30 overpasses nearly match S-NPP, separating resolution effect from time-of-day effect (FA-D4).

nodes.label: Leave-one-season-out validation and coverage
nodes.rationale: Nine folds that never split a firing season; pooled 95% interval coverage must be 0.90-0.97; M1 GLM ships only if pooled MAE >10% below M0.

nodes.label: Never pool raw counts across sensors
nodes.norm_label: never pool raw counts across sensors
nodes.rationale: Counts kept per sensor and pass, normalised by that sensor's cloud-free opportunities, then converted to the common unit (FA-D4, FA-D14).

nodes.label: Seam test (2012 jump is sensor artefact)
nodes.norm_label: seam test (2012 jump is sensor artefact)
nodes.rationale: Headline claim made numeric: d_harm <= 0.25 x d_raw, Chow p<0.01 raw and >0.05 harmonized, with transition season 2011-12 excluded.

nodes.label: Why now: S-NPP/MODIS end of life
nodes.norm_label: why now: s-npp/modis end of life
nodes.rationale: S-NPP products cease 2 Nov 2026 1300 UTC; Terra/Aqua drifting and shutting down late 2026/early 2027, so any future-vs-past comparison crosses a sensor change.

nodes.label: Ranked validation layers 1-7
nodes.rationale: Ordered by evidential strength; only rank 1 expectation is pre-registered; closure cases are illustration only (FA-C3, FA-D11).

nodes.label: Fire record breaks in 2012 (MODIS 1km vs VIIRS 375m)
nodes.norm_label: fire record breaks in 2012 (modis 1km vs viirs 375m)
nodes.rationale: VIIRS detected about 4.8x more fires than Terra+Aqua in one agricultural study; joining records measures satellites, not fires.

nodes.label: Calibration chain Aqua-SNPP-NOAA20-NOAA21
nodes.rationale: beta3 estimated NRT-to-NRT because NOAA-21 is NRT only; NOAA-20 SP/NRT ratio measured separately so beta3 reflects sensor not processing-level difference.

nodes.label: Stratum pooling ladder (rungs 0-5)
nodes.rationale: Total order of pooling; rung 5 (pools day/night) forbidden for night outputs, which are emitted as not observed rather than given a cross-pass beta.

nodes.label: Weakly supervised source classifier
nodes.rationale: Needed because NRT has no type field; location/date/month excluded to prevent learning the labelling rule; type=2 augmentation shares construction with persistence features so footprint-only and ablation are reported.

nodes.label: Kiln heat mixed with crop-residue burning
nodes.norm_label: kiln heat mixed with crop-residue burning
nodes.rationale: Kilns fire Nov-May like residue burning; counted as vegetation fire or discarded when FIRMS labels type=2.

nodes.rationale: Each constant has exactly one source of truth; values shared with the browser are published in meta.json so nothing is hard-coded twice.

nodes.label: Feasibility gates G0-GN
nodes.rationale: Kiln fires continuously (high S, low P) vs harvest burst (low S, high P); G0 is informational only and run after prereg commit so it cannot influence thresholds.

nodes.label: Pre-register, then measure
nodes.rationale: Gate thresholds committed in PREREGISTRATION.md before data analysis; git history is the proof (FA-D2).

nodes.label: Gate branches (full/from2012/partial/nightfire/nokiln)
nodes.rationale: Contract carries split[], split_labels and activity_index so the gate outcome needs no code change.

nodes.label: Untested kiln thermal-detection hypothesis
nodes.rationale: Sub-pixel hot area times temperature may exceed VIIRS threshold especially at night; no published method detects kilns thermally.

nodes.label: Pre-registered rules (PREREGISTRATION.md)
nodes.rationale: Primary-inventory rule applied first, gate season derived second, so the two cannot define each other (v2.1 fix); no rule edited after commit.

nodes.label: Dual-tier release (public vs regulator)
nodes.rationale: A public per-site ranking of private businesses built on a still-validating, urban-biased method could harm kiln owners and workers.

nodes.label: Name check and value check for public export
nodes.norm_label: name check and value check for public export
nodes.rationale: A name check catches the leak you anticipated; a value check catches the one you did not.

nodes.label: Nine Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Precompute, pre-register, never pool raw counts, GEE gives fractions only, clusters public/sites never, every number carries uncertainty, one source of truth per constant, tests never touch real data, boring stack.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md agent operating rules
nodes.rationale: Ten invariants plus a stop-after-three-failures rule so agents cannot weaken tests, thresholds or the pre-registration.

nodes.label: Test isolation (NFR10)
nodes.rationale: No test may read data/raw or data/interim; real-data checks are stage assertions inside the pipeline.

nodes.label: VERIFY-A / VERIFY-S / VERIFY-H
nodes.rationale: Three non-interchangeable verification kinds; an agent may never tick a human VERIFY-H row.

nodes.label: Daily clear-fraction denominators (FireMask 5,7,8,9)
nodes.rationale: Water (class 3) excluded because fires do not occur on water; admitting it would inflate denominators and deflate rates, worst in monsoon and haor basins.

nodes.label: Earth Engine supplies fractions, never counts
nodes.norm_label: earth engine supplies fractions, never counts
nodes.rationale: Numerator (cell-days) and denominator (clear cells) must share one cell set; GEE reduces over its own grid so only the clear fraction is used and cell count comes from our grid.
